critical_code_review_comments: Minor inaccuracy in review-request misc note: The implementation uses MUI ThemeProvider with `mode` prop (palette mode), NOT CssVarsProvider. As a result, document.documentElement does NOT receive the `data-mui-color-scheme` attribute mentioned in the request. The dark/light switching still works perfectly via palette.mode and localStorage 'mediq-theme'. If the agent intended consumers to detect theme via that attribute (e.g., for CSS overrides), they should migrate to experimental_extendTheme + CssVarsProvider. Otherwise, no action required.
Pricing yearly savings copy shows '-30%' chip but Pro pricing is $19→$12 which is ~37% off. Either update the chip to '-37%' or adjust prices. Cosmetic only.
